title: Breakfast at my house
instructions: Omar evdeki kahvaltıyı anlatıyor. Kim ne yiyor, dikkat et.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: We have breakfast at seven o'clock in the kitchen.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: My dad eats bread with cheese and olives.

script.speaker: omar
script.text: My mum only drinks tea. She is never hungry in the morning.

script.speaker: omar
